column4: Three-state matches(); reaper destroys only on ===false; KWR2 vault-stored random key with key id; boot warning. Tests: world-reference, world-hibernation, e2b-world, daytona-world.
Per-candidate catch and control-plane destroy fixed (world-hibernation test). A parked world whose checkpoint keeps failing is still reopened (E2B resume) every sweep, no backoff.
Hibernation and teardown run under registry withoutRecovery(), so sweep open failures never restore or acquire leases. Test: world-hibernation 'never invokes recovery (WD-7)'.
E2B/Daytona world destroy() and provider destroy evict sandbox and state caches; tombstone makes status missing. Tests: e2b-world, daytona-world (WD-3, PS-10).
Keeps two newest plus pinned checkpoints, durable object GC from sweep; reads batched in-sandbox, 32/128 MiB caps; bounded gunzip on restore. Test: checkpoint (WD-4).
Cloud provisioning ignores gitCredentials.sshKey; writes only repository keys lacking a token, and prefers repo-scoped tokens. Test: provision-git (WD-5).

Git image, git-common-dir and worktree mounted at real paths; native agents run inside container via isRemoteAgentWorld. Tests: container-unit, mcp-connections (fake Docker; real-Docker test skipped).
Message regexes replaced by isMissingSandbox (HTTP 404 status or typed SDK error); ENOTFOUND/proxy text no longer means missing. Tests: e2b-world, daytona-world (WD-8).
Hosted default 1 GiB bundle cap before reading, statfs disk headroom check, activity cancellation per chunk, partial file removed. Test: git-transfer (WD-9).
Shared scan: 128-path batches, -z NUL paths, literal pathspecs, non-0/1 grep exit throws; killed git maps to 128. Test: conflict-markers (WD-10).

Restore now uses recorded branch, directory, localPath, authority, identity (checkpoint, e2b-world tests). Fork world repos/authority/identity still come from fork args/project defaults; only siblings recreated.
Restore releases the vanished generation's owned lease before acquiring replacement capacity. Test: checkpoint (asserts one active lease after restore).
EnvironmentWorld forwards addCheckout when the inner world supports it. Test: resources 'forwards addCheckout through environment wrappers (WD-13)'.
Failed teardown marks teardownPending; lifecycle sweep retries control-plane destroy after task terminates and leases/access end, without recovery. Tests: world-teardown, world-hibernation (WD-14).
Hosted Daytona apiUrl must be https://app.daytona.io/api, checked on save and on resolve of stored connections. Test: provider-connections (WD-15).
Daytona exec rethrows SDK errors lacking an integer exitCode instead of returning exit 1. Test: daytona-world (WD-16).
Broker clones now single-branch and publishes run 3-way concurrent (git-broker test), but every publish/merge/refresh still does a fresh clone; mirror cache deferred.
Event scan resumes from durable cursor minus one hour, stops at cursor page, full feed only daily; cursor not advanced on failure. Tests: e2b-world, runner-pools (WD-18).
Checkpoint reads batch up to 128 files/4 MiB per sandbox exec; prepare reuses secret digest cache so unchanged files aren't rewritten. Tests: checkpoint, resource-secret-refresh (WD-19).
buildReview caps changedFiles (1000 entries/64 KiB) for repo and listFiles worlds, reporting total and truncation. Tests: world, activity-review-bounds (WD-20).
Container exec/process/PTY pass only env names as -e; values travel in the docker child environment. Test: container-unit (fake Docker).
Materialized tenant credentials reset inherited credential.helper (isolated env already did), so operator store/keychain helpers neither answer nor save. Test: git-credential (WD-22).
landLocalBranch worktree add/remove now run under withWorktreeLock (finalizeMergeRepo stays outside to avoid nesting). Test: git-broker 'locks local landing (WD-23)'.
brokerEnrollRepository rejects names outside ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*$ before any world command. Test: git-broker (WD-24, five unsafe names).
Restore deletions use rm -f -- and fail on nonzero exit (fork path already did). Covered by checkpoint tests.
Wiki-role finalizeMergeRepo (local and broker landings) runs in the canonical wiki lane, now a cross-process directory lock. Test: merge (WD-26, separate-process race).
Host git helper (worktree worlds, merges) adds core.quotePath=false. buildReview in container/E2B/Daytona worlds still runs in-world git diff/ls-files without it (core.ts:2926-2927).
Local commands, processes, PTYs and memory/worktree exec use scrubbedEnv plus explicit task values instead of process.env. Test: local-execution-env (WD-28).
Worktree core.excludesFile now points to a combined file: inherited global/XDG ignore plus secret rules, with legacy layout migration. Test: resources (WD-29, three sources).
No commit addresses the unnamed stale docs/comments; e.g. e2b.ts:131 still says hosted must set KARMAX_WORLD_REF_KEY, though new refs use the vault key.
E2B/Daytona reference resolution no longer falls back to handle.meta.sandboxId; only sealed KWR1/KWR2 refs. Tests: e2b-world, daytona-world (WD-30).

Pull ingest passes onlyFor=polling org; full-address owner index, first-owner-wins; AgentMail key must list inbox; routes deleted on disconnect/org delete. Tests: agent-mail, mail-pull, autonomy-cleanup, gateway.
Callback requires a signed-in session and consumes OAuth state only for its initiating userId; UNIQUE(provider, accountId) already existed at base. Test: stripe-payments.
/api/vault/fill accepts only login items with explicit domains and username/password/totp fields; fillViaCdp, fillInWorld and cdp-fill require domains. Tests: vault-selection-gateway, world-fill.
claimFill: authorized/settled request must be unexpired and under 30 min old, at most three attempts; merchant must be https registrable domain (tldts, private suffixes rejected). Test: payments.
Vault migrates to per-handle encrypted entry files (no full parse/rewrite); secrets and items capped at 64 KiB, 1000 items per org. Tests: shared-vault, vault-items.
Bodies truncated to 16 KiB, stored inbox trimmed to 1 MiB, IMAP batches 50 msgs/64 KiB, AgentMail responses 2 MiB; >8 MiB legacy inbox errors instead of OOM. Test: agent-mail (AU-6).
Cards require allows(scoped, use-card:<id>) (no capability = no cards), intersected with live and ancestor grants; spend/fill route through cards(). Tests: payments, role-defaults (AU-7).
Spend counts the whole task family (parentTaskId and agent-created) against min of ancestor budgets and card selections. Test: payments 'shares a parent budget (AU-9)'.
Leased key (already checked to be this org's credential) resolves with use-credential:<handle> instead of task caps. Test: agent-secret-env.
expirePaymentSpendRequests now expires authorizing as well as authorized rows, audited once; immediate-rail debit+settle is one transaction rolled back past deadline. Test: payments (AU-10).
Card fill routing now uses isRemoteAgentWorld, the same predicate as agent/MCP placement, so container fills hit the in-container browser. Test: agent-card-fill (both paths).
Sessions owner-bound, signCount persisted (passkey, vault-selection-gateway tests). Hosted/remote passkeys now refused (fail closed); no remote passkey transport, so still unusable hosted.
envFor skips env/api-key/ssh-key items created by another task unless the caller holds use-credential:item:<id>; wildcard grants no longer suffice. Test: vault-items (AU-13).

Blind-use tooltip and comments corrected (vault-use-policy-ui test). Gateway still uses the agent-supplied cdpUrl for local fills/passkeys (server.ts:8489, 6666), only loopback-checked, not task-bound.

Org delete runs deleteOrganizationAutonomy first: vault items and key dirs, card PAN/CVC handles, connector secrets/caches, mailbox secrets, inbox kv and routes. Tests: autonomy-cleanup, subscription-billing.
REGRESSION? mail-pull.ts:124 first poll fetches oldest 50 UIDs per 30s poll, so new mail waits until big mailboxes' history drains. Hosted IMAP/pass-git private hosts blocked; timeouts added.

Reveal validates field before consuming; fill checks access without consuming, consumes only inside resolveText for secret fields after target preflight; username fills never consume. Tests: world-fill, vault-selection-gateway.
Name uniqueness and balance checked before Stripe create; card created inactive, activated after persistence, canceled on later failure. Test: stripe-payments.
platform_request added to SECRET_TOOL_NAMES, so archived activity keeps the tool entry but drops its arguments and results. Test: agent-activity.
Local launchers take an exclusive per-port lock and refuse unowned CDP endpoints; --remote-allow-origins=* removed; launcher-created profiles deleted on exit. Test: chrome-cdp-launcher.
envFor now runs for remote worlds; ssh-key items are written 0600 under .karmax-injection inside the receiving world. Tests: agent-secret-env, vault-items.
Vault keeps five prior encrypted values per handle (deleted with it); blank manual standalone notes rejected, connector snapshots may still clear notes. Tests: shared-vault, vault-items, connectors.
providers GET returns webhook URL/secret and worker script only when the token holds credential:write; readers see providers only. Test: vault-selection-gateway.
Fixed under PS-11: broker audit log is now a 1000-entry ring instead of an unbounded array (still in-memory only). Test: credential-broker-retention.

Skipped as optional LOW (#368). findPaymentAuthorization still matches merchants by two-way substring includes (db.ts:7178).
Skipped as optional LOW (#368). Vault AES-GCM still has no AAD binding ciphertext to handle and no key canary (vault.ts:90-105).
Skipped as optional LOW (#368). VaultItems.list and AgentMail.all still return [] on unparseable kv, so the next write overwrites it (vault-items.ts:238).
Skipped as optional LOW (#368). 1Password write-back still passes the secret in argv (op item edit ... password=<value>, connectors.ts:310).
Skipped as optional LOW (#368). SMTP transport on port 587 still sets no requireTLS, so STARTTLS stripping can downgrade to plaintext (email.ts:193).
Skipped as optional LOW (#368). VaultCardProvider still stores the CVC with the PAN in the vault card secret (payments.ts:267, 281).
Skipped as optional LOW (#368). fill_payment_card still takes agent-supplied cdp_url (loopback-checked only), not pinned to the task's own browser (core.ts:2730).
Skipped as optional LOW (#368). Materialized vault/git-profile key files still persist on host until item or org deletion (vault-items.ts:764, git-profiles.ts:477).
Skipped as optional LOW (#368). GIT_SSH_COMMAND still interpolates key/known_hosts paths unquoted (git-profiles.ts:362, git-credential.ts:36).
Skipped as optional LOW (#368). BudgetService.approve never checks task status, and cancellation doesn't retire pending spend requests (payments.ts:1120).
Skipped as optional LOW (#368). PaymentPolicy.budget is still a bare number; spend across cards of different currencies is summed without currency (payments.ts:1200).
Skipped as optional LOW (#368); gaps unnamed. AU-1..23 fixes added regression tests, but no commit targets AU-37 itself.
